sectors.note:
**TL;DR:** Broad market participation remains absent with zero all-green sectors, leaving market leadership concentrated in high-momentum stalwarts Technology and Healthcare.

Leadership continues to be anchored by Technology and Healthcare, both maintaining sustained top-three positioning over the 1-, 3-, and 6-month horizons. Healthcare is also building short-term strength, advancing into rank 4 alongside a marginal pickup in Financials. 

Meanwhile, Industrials and Real Estate are fading, each slipping one spot over the past five sessions. Defensive and interest-rate-sensitive pockets remain largely out of favor, with Utilities, Consumer Cyclical, and Real Estate anchoring the bottom of the momentum rankings.

## Strength
- **Narrow Breadth:** 0 of 11 sectors are all-green across week, month, quarter, half, and YTD frames, signaling fragile overall participation.
- **Sustained Leadership:** Technology and Healthcare are the only sectors maintaining sustained top-3 rank strength across 1-, 3-, and 6-month intervals.
- **Top YTD Holdings:** Energy holds the #1 YTD rank with a strong 0.767 momentum score, followed closely by Technology at rank 2 (0.933 momentum).

## Movers & Momentum
- **Momentum Leaders:** Technology (0.933 score, rank 2), Healthcare (0.833 score, rank 4), and Energy (0.767 score, rank 1) dominate the top tier.
- **Advancing Sectors:** Over the last 5 sessions, Financials gained +1 spot to reach rank 7 (0.517 momentum) and Healthcare climbed +1 spot to rank 4.
- **Declining Sectors:** Industrials dropped -1 spot to rank 5 (0.517 momentum) and Real Estate fell -1 spot to rank 8 (0.233 momentum).
- **Deep Laggards:** Utilities (0.133 score, rank 10) and Consumer Cyclical (0.167 score, rank 11) remain the weakest momentum profiles across the board.

## Divergences
- **Basic Materials Disconnect:** Basic Materials holds a strong #3 YTD rank despite a soft, sub-50 momentum score of 0.433.
- **Communication Services Spread:** Communication Services ranks low at #9 YTD, yet posts a mid-tier momentum score of 0.533 that outpaces higher-ranking sectors like Industrials and Basic Materials.

industries.note:
**TL;DR:** Narrow market breadth persists with only 6 of 144 groups holding all-green status, led by sustained strength in Oil & Gas Refining & Marketing alongside a sharp 5-day rotation into select consumer and real estate segments.

Market leadership remains heavily concentrated. Top-tier sustained momentum is driven by Oil & Gas Refining & Marketing (momentum 0.952, rank 2) and Diagnostics & Research (momentum 0.931, rank 28), while high-beta tech groups like Electronics & Computer Distribution (0.859) and Semiconductors (0.858) maintain elite YTD positioning. 

A stark rotation away from basic materials and commodities is underway, with severe 5-day rank declines in Paper & Paper Products (-28 spots), Gold (-27 spots), and Other Precious Metals & Mining (-25 spots). Capital is instead rotating into oversold areas, including Department Stores (+20 spots) and Real Estate - Diversified (+21 spots), while consumer discretionary laggards like Gambling (0.028) and Resorts & Casinos (0.104) remain pinned at the bottom.

## Strength
- **All-Green Breadth:** Only 6 of 144 industry groups are positive across all timeframes (week, month, quarter, half, YTD): Oil & Gas Refining & Marketing (0.95 momentum), Diagnostics & Research (0.93), Department Stores (0.85), Health Information Services (0.82), Software - Infrastructure (0.81), and Real Estate - Diversified (0.73).
- **Sustained Leadership:** Groups maintaining a top-36 rank across 1-, 3-, and 6-month horizons include Marine Shipping (0.862 momentum, rank 6), Electronics & Computer Distribution (0.859, rank 3), Insurance - Reinsurance, and Software - Infrastructure.
- **Top Absolute Momentum:** Oil & Gas Refining & Marketing (0.952) and Diagnostics & Research (0.931) stand out as the highest-momentum industries in the market.

## Movers & Momentum
- **Fastest Gainers:** Real Estate - Diversified climbed 21 spots over the past 5 sessions (rank 72, 0.73 momentum), followed closely by Department Stores (+20 spots to rank 55, 0.85 momentum) and Lodging (+18 spots to rank 46, 0.74 momentum).
- **Severe De-escalations:** Paper & Paper Products shed 28 spots to rank 117 (0.35 momentum), Gold fell 27 spots to rank 62 (0.49 momentum), and Other Precious Metals & Mining dropped 25 spots to rank 111 (0.37 momentum).
- **Momentum Troughs:** Extreme underperformance is anchored by Gambling (0.028 momentum, rank 144), Mortgage Finance (0.035 momentum, rank 142), and Solar (0.072 momentum, rank 138).

## Divergences
- **Early Faders:** High-momentum groups showing short-term rank decay include Consumer Electronics (0.79 momentum, -1 spot in 5d), Biotechnology (0.75 momentum, -3 spots), Steel (0.71 momentum, -3 spots), and Banks - Diversified (0.71 momentum, -2 spots).
- **Emerging Movers:** Low-momentum groups staging sharp 5-day rank improvements include Grocery Stores (+11 spots, 0.49 momentum), Waste Management (+11 spots, 0.45 momentum), and REIT - Retail (+6 spots, 0.46 momentum).
